term: decree as a respect in a field
definition: A respect d in a field O true of g at w, at most one field member at w, some member at each accessible world, d sufficing for x at accessible worlds, and x contingent. Treating a decree as a respect in which g is in act is the analyst's supposition under test; the oneRespect model is the branch where no decree is one.
note: See docs/notes/simplicity-collapse-555.md. Stipulative analyst notion for #555; no source is claimed for it.
